name: AgentCore
description: Self-hosted AI incident triage with checkpointed resume and episodic memory. Runs a 4-step pipeline (recall → plan → MCP tools → synthesize) on alerts and posts the analysis to Slack in ~30 s. A crash mid-investigation resumes from the failed step only; resolved incidents write to pgvector so past fixes surface automatically. Works with Ollama.

AGENTCORE_URL.description: The base URL of the running AgentCore server (e.g. http://localhost:3000).

AGENTCORE_TOKEN.description: JWT token for authenticating with the AgentCore server. Required only when authentication is enabled (JWT_SECRET is set on the server).

tools.name: investigate_incident
tools.description: Trigger a full AI investigation of an incident. Recalls similar past incidents from episodic memory, plans tool calls with an LLM, queries logs/metrics/runbooks, and synthesizes a report.

tools.name: get_investigation
tools.description: Fetch an investigation's status, checkpoint timeline (per-step status and durations), and final report if completed.

tools.name: search_incident_memory
tools.description: Semantic search over AgentCore's episodic memory of past incidents and their outcomes. Use to find how similar incidents were resolved before.

tools.name: export_postmortem
tools.description: Export a completed investigation as a Markdown post-mortem (summary, probable cause, affected systems, next actions, checkpoint timeline).
